sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed the PDF currently linked from HSE's district calendars page and verified the dates shown on this page against it.
We checked the full calendar, including staff-only dates, grading-period endings, breaks, graduation dates, and the district's virtual-learning note.
Return dates after Fall, Thanksgiving, and Spring Break are planning dates derived from the published break ranges. The January 5 return after Winter Break is printed directly on the HSE calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does HSE school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first full day for all Hamilton Southeastern Schools students is Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When do HSE students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 4 is a staff orientation and in-service half day. Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for HSE in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 21, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Fishers and HSE High School graduations in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fishers High School graduation is June 2, 2027, and Hamilton Southeastern High School graduation is June 3, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens if HSE cancels school?
calendarFaqs.a: If HSE cancels school, the district calendar says virtual learning days will be used. Families should check current HSE messages for the day's plan.

whatsNew.title: What Changed for HSE in 2026–27
whatsNew.subtitle: Two notable schedule changes from 2025–26.
content: The first student day is August 5, one day earlier than last year's August 6 start.
Fall Break is October 19–23, one week later than last year's October 13–17 break.
